description: FluentFlyout is an open-source Windows flyout replacement featuring media controls, volume controls, taskbar widgets, and Fluent 2 styling.

script: if ($bundles.Count -ne 1 -or $certs.Count -ne 1) { throw 'Unexpected FluentFlyout archive layout: expected one .msixbundle and one .cer in SystemFiles.' }
Write-Host 'FluentFlyout signing certificate is already trusted; updating MSIX directly.'
Write-Warning 'The upstream signing certificate is not trusted. The official setup may request administrator approval to trust it.'
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $bootstrap -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Official Add-AppDevPackage.ps1 was not found.' }
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw ('FluentFlyout upstream setup failed with exit code ' + $LASTEXITCODE) }
if ($packages.Count -gt 1) { throw 'More than one developer-signed FluentFlyout package was found. Uninstall manually to avoid removing the wrong application.' }

if ($packages.Count -eq 1) { Remove-AppxPackage -Package $packages[0].PackageFullName -ErrorAction Stop } else { Write-Warning 'No developer-signed FluentFlyout package found; Microsoft Store packages were left untouched.' }

notes: Installs the developer-provided MSIX bundle, not a portable executable; Windows manages the installed app and its settings.
Initial setup or signing-certificate changes may require interactive administrator consent. Review the certificate carefully: trusting a self-signed root gives it broad trust.
Close FluentFlyout before updates if Windows reports the app is in use. Do not let the Microsoft Store replace this edition.
Uninstalling a Windows app package can delete its local app data; back up settings first.
